desc: Increase carrying capacity with the Photon Sidecar Mag carrier. Useable as a separate mag carrier or can be linked to the Photon holster with the Sidecar link strut. The link strut is injection molded polymer, stronger than Kydex and incredibly flexible so the sidecar configuration will flex to fit and ride comfortably. The belt clip and strut can be attached to either side, for right- or left-handed shooters or for IWB or OWB use. Proudly made in the USA.
